question: What is the leave policy for interns?
expectedAnswer: Interns accrue 1 paid leave day per full month, up to 6 days for a 6-month internship; no carryover between terms or into a full-time role.

question: How many PTO days do full-time employees accrue per year?
expectedAnswer: 18 days per year, accrued at 1.5 days/month, up to 10 days may carry over.

question: How many paid sick days do employees get per year?
expectedAnswer: 8 paid sick days per year, does not carry over; doctor's note required beyond 3 consecutive days.

question: Are interns eligible to work remotely?
expectedAnswer: No, interns must work on-site for the full internship except in cases of documented illness.

question: What is the home office stipend for employees approved for remote work?
expectedAnswer: A one-time $300 stipend; does not apply to interns.

question: How many days per week can an eligible employee work remotely, and when do they become eligible?
expectedAnswer: Up to 3 days per week, after completing the 90-day probationary period.

question: What are the required core working hours?
expectedAnswer: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM in the employee's local time zone, Monday through Friday, excluding company holidays.

question: Within how many days must an expense report be submitted?
expectedAnswer: Within 30 days of the expense being incurred, with an itemized receipt.

question: What is the daily meal reimbursement cap while traveling for business?
expectedAnswer: $75 per day, itemized.

question: Is alcohol reimbursable as a business expense?
expectedAnswer: No, alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances.

question: What is the hotel cost cap for business travel?
expectedAnswer: $220 per night in major metro areas, $150 per night elsewhere.

question: How long does the confidentiality agreement remain in effect after an employee leaves the company?
expectedAnswer: 2 years following the end of employment.

question: When do full-time employees receive performance reviews?
expectedAnswer: Twice a year: a mid-year check-in in June and an annual review in December; new hires also get a 90-day review.

question: How are interns reviewed during their internship?
expectedAnswer: One review at the midpoint and a final review in the last week, which includes a recommendation on a full-time offer.

question: What are the password requirements for internal systems?
expectedAnswer: At least 14 characters, rotated every 180 days, no reuse of the last 10 passwords; MFA is mandatory for remote access.

question: How many paid holidays does the company observe in the United States?
expectedAnswer: 11 paid holidays.

question: Can an employee with 8 months of tenure take paid parental leave?
expectedAnswer: No, paid parental leave requires at least 12 months of tenure; they could request unpaid leave up to 8 weeks instead.
